note: The six power objects. Their effects are invention (rules v1 and v2).

offices.name: the citadel
offices.title: Citadel
offices.effect: Defense +2 against plots. Lets you take an office from a holder who is outside the walls, with no roll.

offices.name: the treasury
offices.title: Treasury
offices.effect: Whoever holds it decides who is paid. Without it, the guard's pay is not taken out for you.

offices.name: the fleet
offices.title: Fleet
offices.effect: Brings 2 months of grain each winter if its holder is friendly. Needed for raids by sea.

offices.name: the generalship
offices.title: Generalship
offices.effect: Commands the army. Needed to March on a place or raid by land.

offices.name: the assembly
offices.title: Assembly
offices.effect: Passes laws and levies. Holding it gives +1 on your votes.
